segments.he:
תּוֹרָה רפג
לִפְעָמִים יֵשׁ מַחֲלֹקֶת בֵּין שְׁנֵי צַדִּיקִים אַף־עַל־פִּי שֶׁשְּׁנֵיהֶם מִשֹּׁרֶשׁ אֶחָד וּשְׁנֵיהֶם גְּדוֹלִים בְּמַעֲלָה מְאֹד, רַק מֵחֲמַת שֶׁאֶחָד מֵהֶם הוּא בִּבְחִינַת חֶסֶד דְּאִתְפַּשֵּׁט לְבַר שֶׁמְּגַּלֶה תּוֹרָתוֹ לַאֲחֵרִים, וְהַשֵּׁנִי הוּא בִּבְחִינַת טוֹב דְּטוּבֵהּ גָּנֵז בְּגַוֵּהּ (עַיֵּן פְּנִים). נִמְצָא שֶׁמַּחֲלֹקֶת שֶׁל צַדִּיקִים נִמְשָׁךְ מֵהַתּוֹרָה. אֲבָל יֵשׁ מַחֲלֹקֶת שֶׁל רְשָׁעִים שֶׁאֵינוֹ נִמְשָׁךְ מֵהַתּוֹרָה כְּלָל, וְעַל־כֵּן בֶּאֱמֶת צְרִיכִין לְהִתְפַּלֵּל לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ, שֶׁבְּאִם רְצוֹן הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ שֶׁיִּהְיֶה עָלָיו רְדִיפוֹת וּמַחֲלֹקֶת, שֶׁיִּהְיֶה עַל כָּל פָּנִים מִבְּחִינַת מַחֲלֹקֶת הַצַּדִּיקִים הַנַּ"ל, בִּבְחִינַת: "אַךְ טוֹב וָחֶסֶד יִרְדְּפוּנִי" (תְּהִלִּים כג, ו):
segments.en:
End of Part One (Kama) — Toirahs 1–286

נ נח נחמ נחמן מאומן

Final section of Part One — major themes:

Conflict as a cover (T208): The wicked who pursue the Tzadik are sent from Heaven — to make the Tzadik scrutinise himself — and also serve as a cover — preventing him from becoming more famous than necessary.

Rosh Hashonah travel (T211): People travel to Tzadikim on Rosh Hashonah because the primary sweetening of that source-of-all-judgments day requires holy thought — and holy thought requires attachment to Tzadikim.

Banishing evil thoughts (T233§2): The impossibility of two simultaneous thoughts is the complete remedy for evil thoughts. Do not shake your head — simply think another thought.

Stories of Tzadikim (T234, T248): Storytelling about Tzadikim purifies thought, sweetens judgments, and was the primary source of arousal for many great Tzadikim. Only one who can distinguish light from darkness — a gift of the Land of Israel — can properly tell such stories.

Commerce as Torah (T280): All commerce is literally Torah. The inner thought must be bound to Torah even while conducting business. Commerce done with faith and inward Torah-thought elevates worlds and holy sparks — equal to prayer.

Find the good point (T282): One of the Rebbe's most beloved and urgent teachings — the foundation for approaching oneself and others. Even the most wicked person has some good point. Finding it lifts them to the scale of merit. Applying it to oneself is the antidote to despair — which the Rebbe calls the worst of all states. The chazzan as one who gathers the good points of an entire congregation. Mashiach will redeem Israel through this very ability.

Shulchan Aruch daily (T286): The Rebbe's strong directive — no day should pass without learning some section of the Shulchan Aruch — even a single section on the road. Complete the four parts and begin again. This is the great clarifier of all one's blemishes.

Completion of Part One: With Toirah 286 — the translation of the entire Kitzur Likutay Moharan Ha-Shalaim, Part One (Kama) is complete — Toirahs 1 through 286. Part Two (Tinyana) follows.

Translation in the merit of Na Nach Nachma Nachman MayUman  ·  May Hashem bless all who learn from it.

  נ נח נחמ נחמן מאומן
